verdict.rationale: Clerk's own docs describe webhooks that deliver event notifications such as user created and user updated, which covers sign-ups and user changes. The official CLI relays webhook deliveries to a local handler and verifies their signatures, which confirms these are signed HTTP callbacks a backend can consume. missing for 10: explicit evidence of sign-in/session event types, a documented full event catalog and delivery/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
